questions.question: 'The Blue Umbrella', 'The Cherry Tree', 'The Hidden Pool' are novels written by who among the following authors?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ruskin Bond**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Ruskin Bond** is a celebrated Indian author of British descent.
 
• He has written numerous novels, short stories, and children's books.
 
• Notable works include 'The Blue Umbrella', 'The Cherry Tree', and 'The Hidden Pool'.
 
• His works are characterized by their simplicity and the depiction of nature and rural life in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ruskin Bond's Literary Contributions**

 
 
• He has written over 500 short stories, essays, and novels.
 
• His first novel, 'The Room on the Roof', won the John Llewellyn Rhys Prize in 1957.
 
• He was awarded the Sahitya Akademi Award in 1992 for his short story collection 'Our Trees Still Grow in Dehra'.
 
• He received the Padma Shri in 1999 and the Padma Bhushan in 2014.
 
 
 
• **The Blue Umbrella**
 
 
• This novella was published in 1980 and is one of Bond's most famous works.
 
• It tells the story of a young girl named Binya and her blue umbrella, exploring themes of kindness and material desire.
 
• The book was adapted into a film directed by Vishal Bhardwaj in 2005.
 
 
 
• **The Cherry Tree**
 
 
• A children's book that illustrates the importance of nature and nurturing.
 
• It follows the story of a young boy named Rakesh who plants a cherry seed and watches it grow.
 
 
 
• **The Hidden Pool**
 
 
• Published in 1966, it is Bond's first novel for children.
 
• The story revolves around three friends and their adventures around a hidden pool in the hills of Mussoorie.

• **He wrote the book 'Kundalini: The Mother of the Universe', which Includes an English translation of 'Lalita Sahasranama. Hence, Option 1 is correct**

• In India, there are Yogis who perform such marvellous feats that Doctors, Scientists and Chemists are unable to solve them, and I may say, are unable to understand them.

questions.question: Who is the author of the novel ‘A Suitable Boy’?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Vikram Seth**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vikram Seth** is the author of the novel **'A Suitable Boy'**__.
 
• 'A Suitable Boy' is one of the longest novels ever published in a single volume in the English language.
 
• The novel was published in **1993** and has been highly acclaimed for its detailed portrayal of post-independence India.
 
• The narrative revolves around the lives of four families and provides a rich tapestry of Indian society and culture.
 
• Vikram Seth is also known for other works such as **'An Equal Music'** and **'The Golden Gate.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Vikram Seth was born on **20th June 1952** in Calcutta, India.
 
• He has received several awards for his literary work, including the **Padma Shri** in 2007.
 
• Seth studied at prestigious institutions such as **The Doon School, Tonbridge School, Corpus Christi College, Oxford, and Stanford University**.
 
• 'A Suitable Boy' was adapted into a television miniseries by the BBC in **2020**.
 
• Vikram Seth's writing often explores themes of love, politics, and social issues, making him a significant figure in contemporary literature.
